chapter.section: Enacted by Chapter 451, 2024 General Session2024Definitions.As used in this chapter:"Body of water" means any natural or man-made accumulation of water, regardless of whether the accumulation of water is static or subject to a force that causes a hydrological current."Governmental entity" means:a court;the Legislature;the legislative body of a political subdivision; oranother entity of the state or a political subdivision, if the entity has adjudicatory or rulemaking authority."Human being" means a member of the species classified as Homo sapiens;"Land" means the solid terrestrial surface or subsurface of the earth."Legal personhood" means:the legal rights and obligations of an individual under the laws of this state; orthe legal rights and obligations of a person other than an individual under the laws of this state."Political subdivision" means the same as that term is defined in Section 63G-7-102."Real property" means any building, fixture, improvement, appurtenance, structure, or other development that is affixed permanently to land."State" means the same as that term is defined in Section 63G-7-102.

Enacted by Chapter 451, 2024 General Session2024Legal personhood restricted.Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a governmental entity may not grant legal personhood to, nor recognize legal personhood in:artificial intelligence;an inanimate object;a body of water;land;real property;atmospheric gases;an astronomical object;weather;a plant;a nonhuman animal; orany other member of a taxonomic domain that is not a human being.
